data.name: ApiAuthentication
data.value: Authentication used

data.name: ApiAuthenticationDescription
data.value: App endpoints use a server-signed RS256 JWT with the App ID as issuer and a nine-minute expiry. Resource endpoints use the discovered enterprise or organization installation's access token. No personal access token, GitHub user OAuth token or browser-provided GitHub token is used.

data.name: ApiAuthorization
data.value: Delegated authorization

data.name: ApiAuthorizationDescription
data.value: The App can access enterprise-wide billing data, but only authorized budgets/destinations reach the browser. Every mutation rechecks identity, ownership and scope-relevant eligibility. Creation/update also validate the amount ceiling and uniqueness. Individual budgets affect the user's consumption across organizations.

data.name: ApiBaseUrl
data.value: API origin

data.name: ApiBaseUrlDescription
data.value: The configured Portal:GitHub:ApiBaseUrl selects GitHub.com or the enterprise's Data Residency API origin. The enterprise placeholder is the enterprise slug; organization and username placeholders are GitHub logins. IDs come from GitHub, not a browser-supplied installation mapping.

data.name: ApiCaching
data.value: Caching

data.name: ApiCachingDescription
data.value: Successful discovery is cached for ten minutes. Tokens are cached until GitHub expiry or one hour, whichever comes first, with a one-minute refresh margin. Identity and Owner roles remain live on every operational request; other inventories are loaded according to the page and budget scope.

data.name: ApiCallMapDescription
data.value: Calls depend on the page, action and stored budget scope. This is an invocation map, not a live request log. Follow an endpoint to inspect its details.

data.name: ApiCallMapTitle
data.value: When are APIs invoked?

data.name: ApiConfigureBilling
data.value: Enterprise: Enterprise billing / Billing - read and write, for cost-center reads and budget reads, creation, updates and deletion.

data.name: ApiConfigureCopilot
data.value: Organization: GitHub Copilot Business - read. This is also referred to as Copilot seat management (organization_copilot_seat_management); it reads existing seats, not license assignments or changes.

data.name: ApiConfigureInstallations
data.value: Enterprise: Enterprise organization installations - read, for organization discovery and validation of existing installations.

data.name: ApiConfigureMembers
data.value: Organization: Members - read, for active owner verification and complete membership inventories.

data.name: ApiConfigureScim
data.value: Enterprise: Enterprise SCIM - read, for the Entra object ID to GitHub EMU identity lookup.

data.name: ApiConventionsTitle
data.value: Authentication, request conventions and safeguards

data.name: ApiCreateBudgetNotes
data.value: Runs only after confirmation, reason, fresh authorization, amount validation and duplicate checks. Cost-center user defaults send the immutable center ID, not its display name. Individual overrides include the user field. Both require usage stopping. A conflict requires reloading, not blind resubmission. Changes are audited; center membership and seats are not modified.

data.name: ApiCreateBudgetPurpose
data.value: Create one authorized monthly AI-credit budget directly on GitHub.

data.name: ApiCreateBudgetRequest
data.value: The common JSON budget payload described below. New alerting is will_alert=false with empty alert_recipients; an individual expiry is included only when selected.

data.name: ApiCreateBudgetResponse
data.value: A successful GitHub response. The portal does not require a top-level budget ID in the creation response; the next dashboard read obtains the persisted budget inventory.

data.name: ApiCreateTokenNotes
data.value: Runs when the relevant installation has no valid cached token. It issues a credential; it does not create an installation or change a budget. A missing token or invalid/too-near expiry is rejected.

data.name: ApiCreateTokenPurpose
data.value: Issue the short-lived installation token used for subsequent enterprise or organization API calls.

data.name: ApiCreateTokenRequest
data.value: The discovered installation_id in the route; a bodyless POST. No permissions or repository subset is requested, so the token inherits the installation's granted access.

data.name: ApiCreateTokenResponse
data.value: token and expires_at. The token remains in backend memory and is never rendered by this page.

data.name: ApiDeleteBudgetNotes
data.value: Runs only after confirmation, reason, fresh access reload and GET-by-ID authorization/fingerprint checks. Deletion is audited and the next dashboard read refreshes the inventory. It does not cancel licenses, remove members or delete cost centers.

data.name: ApiDeleteBudgetPurpose
data.value: Delete one existing authorized budget, not its organization, cost center or user.

data.name: ApiDeleteBudgetRequest
data.value: budget_id in the route; no body or query. The confirmation and reason are portal inputs, not GitHub request fields.

data.name: ApiDeleteBudgetResponse
data.value: A successful GitHub response; an HTTP 204 with no body is accepted.

data.name: ApiEffectRead
data.value: Data reads

data.name: ApiEffectToken
data.value: Token issuance

data.name: ApiEffectWrite
data.value: Budget writes

data.name: ApiErrors
data.value: Failures and concurrency

data.name: ApiErrorsDescription
data.value: At most four GitHub requests are in flight per process, including token issuance and writes. Rate-limited scopes enter a cooldown and return an explicit 502. GitHub 409/412 becomes a 409 conflict; other failures produce explicit errors without raw response bodies or credentials. Fingerprints are optimistic checks, not atomic If-Match transactions. Writes are not automatically retried.

data.name: ApiExpandHint

data.name: ApiFlowBudgetDetailTitle
data.value: Existing budget verification

data.name: ApiFlowBudgetListDescription
data.value: Dashboard, creation and update, including every page for uniqueness checks. Not used by the new-budget form, edit/delete confirmation or deletion.

data.name: ApiFlowBudgetListTitle

data.name: ApiFlowCondition
data.value: Trigger and conditions

data.name: ApiFlowDestinationsDescription
data.value: Dashboard and new-budget form load members/seats of owned organizations and all active centers. Existing-budget reads and writes load scope-relevant inventories; individual budgets omit centers.

data.name: ApiFlowDestinationsTitle
data.value: Eligible destinations

data.name: ApiFlowDiscoveryDescription
data.value: First operational request, then on expiry of the ten-minute discovery cache. Selects administrator-installed organizations belonging to the configured enterprise. Uninstalled organizations are outside portal scope; their logins remain in the complete isolation inventory. Never installs or updates Apps.

data.name: ApiFlowDiscoveryTitle
data.value: Installation discovery

data.name: ApiFlowEndpoints
data.value: Invoked endpoints

data.name: ApiFlowIdentityDescription
data.value: Every budget page read and mutation: resolve the active EMU, confirm its canonical login and check active Owner membership in the configured enterprise's organizations where the App is installed.

data.name: ApiFlowIdentityTitle
data.value: Live identity and ownership

data.name: ApiFlowPhase
data.value: Phase

data.name: ApiFlowTokensDescription
data.value: Before an installation-scoped call only when its cached token is absent or nearing expiry. This POST issues a token, not a budget or installation.

data.name: ApiFlowTokensTitle
data.value: Installation credentials

data.name: ApiFlowWritesDescription
data.value: Only after a confirmed create, update or delete submission with a reason and successful fresh authorization/validation. Writes are audited and never automatically retried.

data.name: ApiFlowWritesTitle
data.value: Confirmed budget changes

data.name: ApiGetBudgetNotes
data.value: Edit/delete confirmation, update and deletion: identity/ownership first, initial read to select inventories, then fresh read and authorization. Update also verifies the listed record; update/delete compare fingerprints. Missing records yield 404 on display or 409 on mutation; changed/unauthorized targets are denied. No If-Match header is sent.

data.name: ApiGetBudgetPurpose
data.value: Read an existing budget's scope and freshly verify its configuration and authorized target.

data.name: ApiGetBudgetRequest
data.value: Requested budget_id in the route; no body or query. The submitted ID is not trusted as authorization.

data.name: ApiGetBudgetResponse
data.value: A single record with id, type, SKU, scope, target, amount, stop flag, alerting and optional expires_at.

data.name: ApiGetCenterNotes
data.value: Identity/name/state must remain consistent with the list. All active center compositions remain necessary for isolation. Only nonempty, unambiguous centers of authorized licensed direct users are exposed as destinations. Centers containing organizations, enterprise teams, repositories or unknown resources are not default destinations. Direct assignments to foreign/ambiguous centers can exclude user-only defaults.

data.name: ApiGetCenterPurpose
data.value: Read all resources assigned to an active cost center and verify its delegated eligibility.

data.name: ApiGetCenterRequest
data.value: The discovered cost_center_id; per_page=100 and page=1, 2, ...; no body.

data.name: ApiGetCenterResponse
data.value: id, name, state and resources[].type/name; Link and has_next_page determine continuation, with a shorter final page as a fallback.

data.name: ApiGetMembershipNotes
data.value: Only role=admin and state=active grant ownership. A 404 is treated as no membership in that organization. At least one owned organization is required. This checks the current person across organizations, not an enterprise-wide list of every owner.

data.name: ApiGetMembershipPurpose
data.value: Verify whether the signed-in GitHub user is currently an Organization Owner.

data.name: ApiGetMembershipRequest
data.value: Each installed organization belonging to the configured enterprise and the resolved username in the route; no body or query. Uninstalled and other-enterprise organizations are not queried.

data.name: ApiGetMembershipResponse
data.value: role and state from the membership object.

data.name: ApiGetUserNotes
data.value: Runs after the SCIM lookup. The returned login must match the resolved login. A 404 means the identity cannot be authorized. This is not GET /user and does not read an authenticated GitHub user's private profile.

data.name: ApiGetUserPurpose
data.value: Verify that the canonical GitHub login resolved from SCIM identifies a real account.

data.name: ApiGetUserRequest
data.value: The resolved username in the route; no body or query.

data.name: ApiGetUserResponse
data.value: login and a positive numeric id.

data.value: EMU identity, organization ownership and Copilot access

data.value: Read-only enterprise discovery

data.name: ApiHeaders
data.value: Request headers

data.name: ApiHeadersDescription
data.value: The version is configured by Portal:GitHub:ApiVersion; the documentation links here target 2026-03-10. Path segments and query values are URI-encoded. Requests with a JSON body use application/json.

data.name: ApiListBudgetsNotes
data.value: Dashboard, creation and update only. Read every page and verify unique IDs/stable counts. Only authorized BundlePricing / ai_credits cost-center user defaults and individual overrides are exposed. The new-budget form and deletion do not enumerate budgets.

data.name: ApiListBudgetsPurpose
data.value: Populate the authorized dashboard and prevent duplicate scope/target budgets.

data.name: ApiListBudgetsRequest
data.value: The configured enterprise; per_page=100 and page=1, 2, ...; no scope or user filter and no body.

data.name: ApiListBudgetsResponse
data.value: budgets, required has_next_page and optional total_count; each record's id, type, SKU, scope, entity/user, amount, stop flag, alerting and optional expires_at.

data.name: ApiListCentersNotes
data.value: Dashboard, destination form and cost-center budget operations; omitted for individual budgets. Read every active center's full composition to preserve isolation. Unknown states, duplicate IDs and unexpected list pagination fail closed. Centers are never created or modified.

data.name: ApiListCentersPurpose
data.value: Obtain the enterprise's cost-center inventory before determining which centers the owner can administer.

data.name: ApiListCentersRequest
data.value: The configured enterprise; no body or query filter. Deleted centers are excluded locally.

data.name: ApiListCentersResponse
data.value: costCenters with id, name and state.

data.name: ApiListInstallationsNotes
data.value: Require exactly one active installation on the configured enterprise and at least one installed organization belonging to it. Uninstalled organizations are outside portal scope; installations from other enterprises are excluded. Duplicate IDs/logins, suspended in-scope installations and incomplete pagination fail closed.

data.name: ApiListInstallationsPurpose
data.value: Discover the App's existing enterprise and organization installations without maintaining installation IDs.

data.name: ApiListInstallationsRequest
data.value: per_page=100 and page=1, 2, ...; no body. Follows the Link header's next-page indicator.

data.name: ApiListInstallationsResponse
data.value: Installation array: id, target_type, account.slug for enterprises, account.login for organizations and suspended_at.

data.name: ApiListMembersNotes
data.value: After owner verification, enumerate only owned organizations. Members: read covers non-public membership. Duplicate/incomplete inventories fail closed. Shared membership elsewhere does not revoke an otherwise eligible licensed user.

data.name: ApiListMembersPurpose
data.value: Build the complete current membership inventory used to authorize user budgets and attribute cost-center resources.

data.name: ApiListMembersRequest
data.value: Each owned org; per_page=100 and page=1, 2, ...; no body or role filter. Follows the Link next-page indicator.

data.name: ApiListMembersResponse
data.value: An array of member objects; each login is collected.

data.name: ApiListOrganizationsNotes
data.value: Read every enterprise organization, including uninstalled/unowned ones, to preserve complete cost-center attribution. Only the intersection with existing App installations is used for owner/member/seat checks. Empty, duplicate or incomplete enterprise inventories are rejected; missing installations elsewhere do not block installed organizations.

data.name: ApiListOrganizationsPurpose
data.value: Read the complete enterprise organization inventory and match it against administrator-installed Apps.

data.name: ApiListOrganizationsRequest
data.value: The configured enterprise slug; per_page=100 and page=1, 2, ...; no body. Follows the Link next-page indicator.

data.name: ApiListOrganizationsResponse
data.value: An array of organizations; each login is collected into the enterprise inventory.

data.name: ApiListSeatsNotes
data.value: The portal intersects seats with current members, then takes the union across owned organizations. Duplicate assignees and inconsistent/incomplete seat counts are rejected. The official endpoint also accepts Administration: read, but the portal uses the narrower GitHub Copilot Business permission. No Copilot subscription or license is changed.

data.name: ApiListSeatsPurpose
data.value: Read existing Copilot seat assignments to identify licensed members of the owned organizations.

data.name: ApiListSeatsRequest
data.value: Each owned org; per_page=100 and page=1, 2, ...; no body. Follows the Link next-page indicator.

data.name: ApiListSeatsResponse
data.value: seats[].assignee.login and optional total_seats; seats with no assignee are not user destinations.

data.name: ApiPayloadAlerting
data.value: New budgets send will_alert=false and alert_recipients=[]. Updates preserve the alerting object from the current GitHub budget instead of overwriting recipients.

data.name: ApiPayloadAmount
data.value: budget_amount is a nonnegative whole monthly USD amount per user within the configured maximum, not a credit count (1 USD = 100 AI credits). It covers included and additional consumption. prevent_further_usage must always be true.

data.name: ApiPayloadDescription
data.value: These are the fields the portal sends, not the entire GitHub schema. Some integration details are stricter than, or clarified beyond, the generated REST schema.

data.name: ApiPayloadExpiry
data.value: Only an individual user override can have an expiry. A selected future UTC date is sent as yyyy-MM-dd; it is omitted on creation when absent. On user updates, null explicitly removes an existing expiry.

data.name: ApiPayloadProduct
data.value: Other products, repository budgets and enterprise-wide budgets are outside the portal's mutation scope.

data.name: ApiPayloadReason
data.value: The required reason and Entra/GitHub actor identity are recorded in backend audit logs; they are not fields in the GitHub budget payload. No secret, token or live enterprise inventory is included in this reference.

data.name: ApiPayloadScopes
data.value: Cost-center per-user default and individual override only. Both cap each user's included and additional consumption. Individual limits affect consumption across organizations.

data.name: ApiPayloadTarget
data.value: Cost-center user defaults send the immutable center ID, even when reads return a name. For individual overrides, budget_entity_name is empty and the separate user field contains the GitHub login.

data.value: Budget payload used by POST and PATCH

data.name: ApiPermissionsApproval
data.value: The administrator installs the App on the enterprise and only the organizations to include in portal scope, without repository permissions. At least one in-enterprise organization installation is required. Uninstalled organizations are excluded; suspended in-scope installations fail explicitly. Approve changed permissions on existing installations; discovery is cached for ten minutes, or the application can be restarted.

data.name: ApiScimUsersNotes
data.value: Runs on each access reload. Requires exactly one result matching oid with active=true. A profileUrl must be a valid single-account HTTPS URL on the configured GitHub host. No email/display-name mapping is used and no SCIM user is provisioned or modified. The endpoint supports installation tokens with Enterprise SCIM: read.

data.name: ApiScimUsersPurpose
data.value: Resolve the signed-in corporate identity to one active GitHub Enterprise Managed User.

data.name: ApiScimUsersRequest
data.value: filter=externalId eq "ENTRA_OBJECT_ID", URI-encoded from the authenticated oid claim; no body. This is the enterprise SCIM Users endpoint, not organization SCIM.

data.name: ApiScimUsersResponse
data.value: totalResults and Resources; externalId, active, profileUrl and, as a fallback when profileUrl is absent, userName.

data.name: ApiUpdateBudgetNotes
data.value: Runs after a fresh access reload, GET by ID, fingerprint comparison, authorization, amount and duplicate checks. Scope and target cannot be changed: delete and create instead. Existing alert recipients/settings are preserved. Individual budgets must retain usage stopping. Changes are audited.

data.name: ApiUpdateBudgetPurpose
data.value: Change the amount, usage-stop setting or permitted individual expiry of an existing authorized budget.

data.name: ApiUpdateBudgetRequest
data.value: budget_id and the common JSON payload below, preserving current budget_alerting. Cost centers use immutable IDs. User expiry is explicitly null when removing it.

data.name: ApiUpdateBudgetResponse
data.value: A successful GitHub response; the next dashboard read refreshes the budget configuration.
